alfworld-player.name: alfworld-player
key_points: Don't try commands not in the admissible list — they will fail
Don't include quotes, numbering, or explanations — reply with bare command only
Don't rush to use items before finding them — explore first

Don't re-clean an item after already completing the clean sequence (`move to sinkbasin` → `take back`). Once cleaned, proceed directly to the destination. Repeating the clean step wastes turns and can cause loops.

STOP after your final task-satisfying action — never issue `look`, `inventory`, `help`, or write natural language explanations after completing the objective. The game only accepts bare admissible commands. After the last action that com...
NEVER open a container just to verify the item is inside. If you placed the item and closed it, it's there. Re-opening to check wastes turns and triggers verification loops.

LOOP DETECTION — hard rule: If you've issued `look` 3+ times consecutively (or the same command 3+ times in a row), STOP immediately. Do NOT issue it again. Instead, check: (1) Have I completed the task? If yes, stop entirely. (2) If not...
open/close loops: If you find yourself alternating `open cabinet X` → `close cabinet X` → `open cabinet X`, STOP. You've already done what's needed. Check task completion and stop entirely.
